description: ENF-1 batch C: deltas against Input/model.json used by the restart probe 95-rename-identity-restart.json (run-behavior-probes.ps1 -RestartRevisionVariant: boot 1 writes rows, the app is regenerated from this revision into the same Output so App/data survives, boot 2 reads the rows under the new names). renameField / renameConcept keep whatever uid the field/concept carries; "renamedFrom": true also declares the old name, "dropUid": true removes the uid. renameWithoutIdentity is the manual red proof: the same field renames with neither a uid nor a renamedFrom must NOT keep the data (python scripts/quality/behavior_probes/run_probes.py --probes-dir NPDevSamples/dsl-conformance-max/behavior-probes --materialize-revision rename-identity.json:renameWithoutIdentity --out-dir <scratch>). renameConceptByUid reproduces REG-305: a concept renamed by its uid alone is classified DESTRUCTIVE_DROP_TABLE + create and the boot refuses (no table-identity store exists), so it cannot share a revision with 95 until REG-305 is fixed.
